from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFixedAssets(BaseModel):
    """Fixed assets reported in one company's financial statement for the period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name from this document")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock/security code if provided")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period this data covers")
    fixed_assets_value: float | None = Field(description="The fixed assets amount as reported in numeric value")
    fixed_assets_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount, e.g., '元', 'CNY'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line or excerpt containing the fixed assets value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_fixed_assets: list[CompanyFixedAssets]
